name: DeadInternetTheory
shortDescription: Local-first content-agent orchestrator: research, generate and publish posts and media, with human approval gates and audit trails.
description:
DeadInternetTheory is a local-first marketing and content-agent orchestrator. You plug in a product or content lane, configure supervised marketing/content agents, research relevant communities and approved sources, then generate posts, scripts, images and voice/video assets. Everything goes through human approval gates, dry-run scheduling, export, and publishing through owned or authorized social accounts.

It's an MVP that's pivoting: FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, Celery/Redis workers, Postgres models, tests, and extensive planning docs. The direction is a visible content-production pipeline with agent handoffs, source provenance, human approval and audit trails.

Out of scope by design: fake engagement, sockpuppet networks, ban evasion, automated likes/votes/follows/DMs and mass replies.
